text: Chapter 15: Coenubia's Awakening@The Village of Lixis
■Next Mission\nMove from Floriso Trail to\nFango Village to start.
You don't see any Lixi in Fango Village.\nIt's just a desolate village that is teeming with Coenubias.\nDefeat them and delve deeper into the village!
As you step into the square, a mysterious voice greets you\nand Gioco, a Coenubia monster, appears!\nIt's trying to attack Anono! Defeat it immediately!
Anono suddenly runs off, as if possessed! It will be\ndangerous if another Coenubia shows up and attacks him!\nLet's go after him and calm him down!
You follow Anono to the Izolara Underground Passage.\nThe place is marked by countless traces of battle.\nLet's look for an exit to get back to the surface now!
